title: Monserrat well worth the trip.  Views amazing.
text: This Viator tour to Monserrat from Barcelona was excellent. Can recommend.  Our driver/guide who was excellent soon has us in Monserrat.  Amazing views all the way.  Guide imparted much information (but not too much to make you want to walk away) which was fabulous.   Can highly recommend the funicular to the top.  The views were spectacular.  Time to also see through the Basilica with its black Madonna or a stroll through the various shops.
author: MSTwo

title: Awesome Hike of Montserrat Mountain
text: Fermi was a great tour guide. He was an extremely experienced climber who was knowledgeable about Montserrat Mountain, the monastery, the Black Madonna, the hermitages and all of the trails on the mountain. Fermi brought delicious sandwiches, nature bars and had ample water for our hike. He took pictures for us and provided  us with an awesome day of hiking.There were vendors for a farmers market in the parking lot that had delicious cheese and fig treats. Definitely taste and buy if you 👍 Recommend this tour and Barcelona Hiking Guides 💯 % Definitely would book again.😎
author: J4847VIstephenb

title: Great day out
text:
This a great walk that is expertly guided by Fermi. He is very knowledgable and passionate about the Monserrat region. You will need a little bit of fitness, but as any good guide does, he goes at your pace. The provided lunch was tasty.

If you want to find the hidden gems of this area. the i cannot recommend them enough.

Than you for a great day.
author: Nomad799843

title: The most amazing experience!
text: I went for a guided Montserrat tour and it was the best guided tour I have ever booked 😁 I felt safe, but also challanged a bit (to climb some spectacular areas). I came back to hostel tired, happy and proud. Mix of fantastic emotions ❤️ Can't recommend Fermi enough. This trip could not be any better. Fantastic guide, fantastic time!
author: EwelinaMarvel

title: Amazing views! Perfect trip for hikers!
text: We ended up getting a personal tour of Monserrat from Femi as we were the only ones on the trip that day! Femi was great and took to three peaks all with amazing views. One was a place where there were no other tourists so you could really enjoy the tranquility. You could tell Femi loved Monserrat and he shared with us that he is aiming to climb every peak with his wife - I think they are currently on 170ish of 208!
author: connorcmp

title: Great
text: Really loved it, amazing hike and the guide was really nice. Good lunch provided. Was an authentic sandwich. Get to see the black madona.
author: 386sharnm

title: Best Day Trip
text: If you love outdoors, this is a MUST. Our group of 5 hiked with Fermi in late May. We would never have experienced the trails like we did without his expertise. He knows that mountain well and guided us through an adventurous hike. You can take an "easier way" or the "not so easy" way. We chose "not so easy" and LOVED it. We felt safe and scrambled on the rocks. Excellent lunch was included and we even saw mountain goats. HIGHLY HIGHLY RECOMMEND.
author: 944aes

title: Fantastic & Incredible day
text: Incredible views, our guide taking us off the tourist path,  climbing to 4 peaks, unexpectedly coming upon mountain goats,  peacefulness and stillness of our surroundings,  learning about the hermitages/history/the plants and flowers, picking and eating wild asparagus!
author: Rachel_N

title: Exceeded my expectations!
text: I thoroughly enjoyed the history and beautiful view  of Montserrat.  My guide was an experienced climber and very knowledgeable of the monastery.  The goat encounter on the hiking descent was priceless!
author: Stormtrail

title: Really great experience!
text: We went to Barcelona for vacation and near the end we wanted to see some of the beautifal nature scenery. Therefore we booked the hiking tour to Montserrat. We have to admit that this was one of the most beautiful landscape we have ever seen. Our guide was very professional and knew everything about these mountains. Since it was our first hiking trip we were unsure and felt uncomfortable in some situations. But our guide managed to lead us through the mountains with confidence and good sense of humor.
